topApps.description: Vima is a GPS based tracking app for people who want to keep track of their walking fitness goals. It is an app aimed at simplicity that allows walkers to keep track of their walks easily without a lot of unnecessary stuff getting in the way. Great for tracking your evening dog walks. APPLE WATCH Easily start, pause, resume, and save a walk without ever getting your phone out of your pocket. Check your distance, speed, time, and altitude from your Apple Watch in realtime. STEP TRACKING Keep track of your daily steps and hit your long term goals. STATS AND MAPS Vima tracks speed, distance, altitude, and time. It also gives you a map showing where you have been while you are saving a walk. COLOR CODED When viewing saved walks your route shows up on the map color coded by speed. It shows where you went the fastest (green) and where you were slowest (red). VOICE SUMMARY Don't want to look at the screen every few minutes? You can have the app tell you updates on your progress in set distance and/or time intervals. SPLIT TIMES Added splits to the history review page. Choose from 9 different distances and see how each section of your workout went. CALORIES See calories burned. Set your weight in settings and get your calories burned in real time and on the history page after your run. SHOE TRACKING Track the distance on your walking shoes so you know when it's time to replace them before they start causing problems PAUSE AND RESUME Pause the workout to catch your breath or chat with a friend and then resume when you get back to it. FACEBOOK & INSTAGRAM Share your workout with your friends on Instagram or Facebook with our easy to use integration. UNITS The supports both standard and metric units. HEALTH KIT Apple Health permissions allow us to enhance your data as well as saving your workout information to Apple Health. If you've read this far, you should definitely give Vima a shot. We think you'll love it, and if there is anything you'd like to see for the app in the future just let us know. We love hearing from our users. topApps.description: Decision Log is a tool for documenting important decisions, personal and professional. You record not just the decision itself, but why it was made, what the options were, and what comes out of it. So you can revisit your choices, learn from them, and spot patterns. Decide with clarity. Learn from experience. Every day you make decisions, at work, in life, in small habits. Unrecorded, they slip away quickly: why you're doing something, what the context was, what you're thinking. Decision Log helps you capture them, so you can see what really works and how things change over time. Not a journal. Not a habit tracker. Something that was missing in between. In a journal, important decisions drown between daily entries. In a habit tracker, you tick off days, but you never write down why you started, or why you stopped. Decision Log captures what gets lost in both: context, motivation, and the history of changes behind every decision. A habit, an experiment, a tool switch, a resolution — all in one place, with an awareness that grows over time. A decision without context is just a faded memory. You change your diet, buy a flat, leave a project. A few months later, you remember what happened, but not why. And without the "why," you don't know if the decision worked or what the experience taught you. WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE - Track progress — milestones, statuses, outcomes - Overwrite past decisions — replacement chains keep the history visible - Collections, filters and search - Simple ready-to-use or customisable statuses and sections - Built-in templates or your own - Clean Markdown editor - Full history of changes - Import / Export (.md, .txt, ADR) WHEN DECISIONS PILE UP — PRO - Focus mode with Workbench - Stats dashboard — pace, patterns, status breakdown - Decision reviews — a regular rhythm for revisiting decisions that haven't been touched in a while - Experiments with end dates - Hints for missing updates - Updates — see how a decision changed over time - No limits on collections, templates and pinned decisions IT'S FOR YOU IF: - You set goals and want to act in line with what motivates you, not just tick off tasks - You feel like you keep repeating the same mistakes, and finally want to capture them - You keep a journal, but your most important decisions and conclusions drown in daily entries - You want structure that breaks decision paralysis and overthinking - You analyse and overthink a lot, and need a place to organise it - Your priority lists keep shifting, but the history disappears with them. You don't know what dropped off and why, what came back, or which time around this is - You make decisions that shape your life or career, and want to document them deliberately - You feel like you're constantly changing things, but can't see the bigger picture Start for free. topApps.description: AI Decision: Decision Log Most decisions don’t fail because they’re bad. They fail because we forget why we made them. AI Decision helps you capture decisions, track assumptions, and review outcomes over time — so you can learn from what actually happened, not just what you hoped would happen. Track decisions, not tasks This app isn’t a to-do list or a habit tracker. It’s a simple space to log important decisions and reflect on them later. Each decision includes: - The decision itself - The expected outcome - The key assumption behind it - A review date to look back Capture the assumption Every decision depends on something being true. By writing down your main assumption, you make your thinking visible — and easier to review later. This simple step helps reduce repeated mistakes and hindsight bias. Review when it matters Set a future review date for each decision. When it’s time, you’ll be reminded to reflect: - Did the expected outcome happen? - What surprised you? - Would you make the same decision again? Over time, this creates a personal decision history you can actually learn from. AI-powered reflection Use AI-powered reflection prompts to spot potential blind spots and overlooked risks. AI Decision does not give advice or make decisions for you. It simply helps you ask better questions and reflect more clearly. Simple, private, and focused - No accounts or logins required (anonymous mode) - Clean, distraction-free design - Your data stays private Sign-in options may be added in future versions. Built for long-term thinking AI Decision is designed for: - Founders and indie builders - Investors and strategists - Creators and solo professionals - Anyone who makes important decisions and wants to learn from them This app won’t tell you what to decide. It helps you remember why you decided - and what happened next.

Track client decisions before the reasoning gets lost. Client work is full of decisions. Materials get swapped, layouts revised, timelines shifted, scope adjusted. Each one happens for a reason. A week later, nobody can reconstruct why. A month later, the client questions a call everyone agreed to. You don't lose this because you're careless. You lose it because there's no fast, low-friction place to put it. Marqo is a decision log for client work. A focused place to record what changed and why, tied to a project, organized so it's easy to review later. WHAT CHANGED, WHY IT CHANGED, WHAT IT AFFECTS Every decision has three fields: - What changed: a short, clear description of the decision - Why: the reasoning behind it, captured at the moment it's made - Affects (optional): budget, timeline, or scope it touches No status columns. No assignees. No priority flags. Just a running record of what happened and why. SHARE A CLIENT-READY LOG IN ONE TAP When a phase of work is done, export any project as a standalone, read-only log formatted as a professional handoff. It opens in any browser with no login, no account, and no expiring link. The client sees the project, every decision by month, what changed, why, and when. Nothing more. On iPhone it opens the standard share sheet, so it goes straight to Mail, Messages, AirDrop, or Files. NOT NOTES. NOT PROJECT MANAGEMENT. Keep using the tools you already have for briefs, references, and deliverables. Use Marqo for the record of what changed, why it changed, and what it affects. It captures the reasoning at the moment it's made and turns any project into a client-readable record with one tap. SOUND FAMILIAR? - You've had to explain a decision on a client call you made six weeks ago - Your reasoning is buried in Slack, email, or a thread you can't find - A client questioned a decision, and you went looking for an answer you already knew - You reversed a decision and the client has no idea why the first one happened - You do careful, considered work, and your clients only see the outcome WHAT'S INSIDE - Projects: create one on the fly while capturing, or assign later. Note the client it belongs to. - Unassigned view: capture first, organize later - Search across what, why, and affects - Inline edit and delete, with a two-step confirm. No popups. - Backup and restore: export all data as a portable file, restore it on any device after seeing exactly what's inside - Local-first: your data lives on your device WHO IT'S FOR Freelance designers and small teams doing project-based client work, where decisions compound and the relationship depends on a clear record of what changed and why. Interior designers, brand and product designers, consultants, architects, and anyone managing client work where scope and direction shift throughout a project. WHY I BUILT IT I lost the reasoning behind my own client decisions twice: once freelancing, once inside a company, where it cost the team real trust. The tools I tried held the what and never the why. So I built the one that does. SUBSCRIPTION Both plans start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Marqo Monthly: $12.99/month. Marqo Annual: $129.99/year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Privacy policy: https://getmarqo.app/privacy.html Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

topApps.description: Reckon ranks hypotheses by what hasn't been knocked down — not by what has the most support. Most decision tools let you write a long pros-and-cons list and call it analysis. That doesn't help — you can rationalize anything in prose. Reckon makes you compare every piece of evidence against every hypothesis and ranks them by Heuer's ACH technique (the method CIA analysts use): fewest refutations first, with a tiebreak on most support. WHAT YOU GET • A starter library: pick from six pre-built example boards (shortseller, founder, researcher, investigator, life decision, doctor) or describe your situation in a paragraph and let on-device AI seed the matrix for you. • Inline bias guardrails: when one hypothesis collects evidence all in the same direction, Reckon flags it. "Bears out" without "Cuts against" is the structural signature of confirmation bias. • Falsifier pre-commitment: state up front what evidence would prove a hypothesis wrong. The app reminds you whether that evidence ever showed up. • Steel-manning before ruling out: before you dismiss a hypothesis, Reckon asks for the strongest case for it. Stops you from throwing out the right answer too early. • Pre-mortem: after you reach a conclusion, the app asks you to imagine being wrong about it in a year. Catches wishful thinking that even refutation-first scoring misses. • Calibration tracking: when you finalize, set your confidence (0–100%) and a check-in date (1 week to 1 year). Come back when the date arrives, log the actual outcome, and Reckon shows your calibration curve over time. Are you actually right when you say you're 80% sure? • Strict Bayes mode (optional): set explicit priors per hypothesis and the matrix shows real Bayesian posterior probabilities updating with each rating, using likelihood ratios per Tetlock/Heuer convention. Real probability, not a heuristic. • Plain English mode: turns off the celestial vocabulary if you'd rather see "Hypotheses / Evidence / Matrix" than "Stars / Observations / Star chart." Same depth, less poetry. • Templates: save your hypothesis structure (e.g. forensic-accounting suspects, differential-diagnosis options) for reuse. Faster on your 12th board than your 1st. PRIVACY Local-only. Your boards, evidence, conclusions, and calibration history stay on your device. No server, no analytics, no ads. AI seed runs entirely on-device via Apple Intelligence — your situation never leaves your phone. WHY ACH Confirming evidence is cheap. Refuting evidence distinguishes. Most decision tools amplify confirmation bias by rewarding biggest positive sum. Reckon does the opposite. iOS 17+. AI seed and Strict Bayes posterior require iOS 26+ on Apple Intelligence-capable devices.

topApps.description: PoliTruth turns the public record into clear, scannable profiles so you can see what your representatives actually said versus what they actually did. Search any member of Congress and get an honest snapshot in seconds: which promises they kept, which they broke, where they stand on the issues you care about, and who funds them. WHAT YOU GET Promise Score See how often a politician keeps their word. The score is the share of resolved promises that were kept, so you get one honest number instead of spin. Ethics Score and Grade A financial integrity profile drawn from public disclosure records, mapped to a clear 0 to 100 score and a letter grade. Kept, Broken, and In Progress Every profile breaks down promises and key votes by outcome, with the context behind each one. Funding Snapshot See money raised, corporate PAC dollars, and reported stock holdings at a glance. Leaderboards Rank politicians by ethics score, promise keepers, and most broken promises. Compare Put two politicians side by side and compare their records directly. Find My Reps Enter your state or ZIP and instantly see the federal officials who represent you. Share Cards Generate a clean accountability card for any politician and share it anywhere. BUILT TO BE FAIR PoliTruth is not affiliated with any political party, campaign, or PAC. We apply the exact same scoring method to every politician regardless of party. A broken promise counts the same whether it comes from a Democrat, Republican, or Independent. The goal is not to push a side. It is to hold everyone to the same standard. Profiles are built from verifiable public record: campaign statements, official voting records, sponsored and cosponsored legislation, public ethics and financial disclosure filings, and reputable reporting. PoliTruth is a fast, neutral starting point. Always verify with primary sources before relying on any single claim. Coverage is strongest for sitting members of Congress. Officials in non legislative roles may have lighter records. Light and dark mode included. Know the score before the spin.
